stories.title: BBC《Blue Planet III》保留不完美镜头，在 AI 时代证明真实性

stories.sourceTitle: Pennsylvania will require labels on AI-generated ads
stories.summary: 州长 Josh Shapiro 签署《Artificial Intelligence Deceptive Advertising Act》，要求显著由 AI 生成的图像、视频、音频或文本广告进行披露。
stories.analysis: 州级立法把 AI 广告透明度变成合规要求，广告主和平台需要建立可审计的标注流程。

stories.title: TechCrunch 盘点 AI 失败项目：从苹果 Siri 延期到 OpenAI“超级应用”发布
stories.sourceTitle: The AI graveyard: a running list of projects and startups that didn’t make it
stories.summary: TechCrunch 整理了一份 AI 项目和初创公司“墓地”清单，记录关闭或未达预期的案例，包括苹果多次延期的 Siri AI 和 OpenAI 混乱的“super app”发布。
stories.analysis: 这份清单提醒市场，AI 热潮并不等于产品成功，交付能力和预期管理仍是淘汰赛关键。
stories.sourceExcerpt: From Apple's repeatedly delayed Siri AI to OpenAI's messy "super app" launch, here's a look at the AI projects that shut down or missed expectations.

stories.title: Block 发布新语音模型，可在 MacBook M4 Max 本地运行且拟人感强
stories.sourceTitle: Block’s new voice model sounds eerily human
stories.summary: Block 表示新语音模型能本地运行在 MacBook M4 Max 上，TechCrunch 称其声音听起来异常像真人。
stories.analysis: 本地运行的高拟真语音模型会降低语音交互门槛，同时把隐私和滥用风险推到端侧。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Block said that the voice model can run locally on a MacBook M4 Max

stories.title: 研究：近 500 场选举中 Grok 多推荐共和党，GPT 多倾向民主党
stories.sourceTitle: Forced to pick, Grok’s AI model chooses Republicans. OpenAI’s picks Democrats.
stories.summary: 一项研究发现，Grok 在近 500 场选举竞选中压倒性推荐共和党候选人，而 OpenAI 的 GPT 更偏向民主党，两者在超过 90% 的竞选中意见不一致。
stories.analysis: 模型政治倾向差异说明训练数据和对齐策略会直接影响信息推荐，选举场景需要更严格的透明度和审计。
stories.sourceExcerpt: A new study found Grok's AI overwhelmingly recommends Republican candidates while OpenAI's GPT favors Democrats, with the two AI models disagreeing in more than 90% of nearly 500 election races.

stories.title: TechCrunch 盘点可驻留短信的 AI 代理：通用助手、家庭、旅行和工作场景
stories.sourceTitle: Here are the top AI agents that can live in your text messages
stories.summary: TechCrunch 列出值得关注的短信内 AI 代理，覆盖通用助理以及面向家庭、旅行和工作需求的设计。
stories.analysis: 短信入口把 AI 代理从独立 App 拉回高频通信场景，但隐私、垃圾信息和平台控制权会成为竞争焦点。
stories.sourceExcerpt: We created a list of the most notable AI agents that can live in your text messages, from general assistants to agents designed for families, travel, and work.

stories.title: Jack Dorsey 的 Block 发布 Dessa：只用人类对话训练的 AI 模型
stories.sourceTitle: Jack Dorsey’s Block made an AI model that talks to you like an awkward new friend
stories.summary: Block 宣布 AI 模型 Dessa，称其“从零开始、只用人类对话训练”，并展示了一些略显尴尬、怪异的真人聊天记录。
stories.analysis: 用纯对话数据训练可能让交互更自然，但也可能放大口语中的偏见和不稳定，需要看实际评测。

stories.sourceTitle: Now Google says it might use your Gmail and Google Photos data to target ads
stories.summary: Google 修改隐私政策，为个性化 AI 功能加入例外条款，可能意味着 Gmail 和 Google Photos 的个人数据会被用于定向广告；Android Authority 发现了这一变化。

stories.title: Meta 因出版商反对 AI 抓取而推迟新商业条款

stories.summary: 过去一个月，浏览器中的 Halo、iPhone 上的 Wind Waker、混合现实中的 Super Smash Bros. 等非官方复古游戏项目在网络上走红。

stories.summary: Meta 调整商业条款，删除了暗示可自由用新闻网站训练 AI 的表述，但法律专家认为这些修改不足以消除担忧。

stories.title: OpenAI 解释 FDE：forward deployed engineering 在 OpenAI 意味着什么
stories.sourceTitle: What FDE means at OpenAI
stories.summary: OpenAI 发文说明 forward deployed engineering 在 OpenAI 内部的含义。
stories.analysis: FDE 把工程能力前置到客户现场，反映 OpenAI 正在加强企业落地和定制化交付。
stories.sourceExcerpt: What forward deployed engineering means at OpenAI

stories.title: AT&T 与 OpenAI 合作，用 AI 改造内部法律工作

stories.analysis: 法律部门是生成式 AI 的高价值场景，重点不在替代律师，而在知识检索、需求受理和审查效率。
stories.sourceExcerpt: AT&T is working with OpenAI to make legal knowledge easier to access. Learn how its LegalEdge team is rethinking intake and scaling legal judgment.

stories.sourceTitle: Broad access through consistent standards

stories.analysis: 当模型通过更多渠道分发，统一安全标准是 OpenAI 控制生态风险的关键，也会影响合作伙伴的合规成本。
stories.sourceExcerpt: How OpenAI works with distribution partners to uphold consistent safeguards, support responsible access, and clarify expectations in our Usage Policies.

stories.sourceTitle: OpenAI models are coming to Google Cloud

stories.sourceExcerpt: OpenAI and Google Cloud are bringing frontier models and Codex workflows to Gemini’s Model Garden, available through Google Cloud Marketplace.

stories.analysis: 收购垂直行业运营公司显示 OpenAI 正从模型提供转向行业流程深挖，生命科学可能成为企业级落地重点。
stories.sourceExcerpt: OpenAI is acquiring Orchestra Bio to bring AI-powered operations to life sciences R&D, helping biopharma teams accelerate drug development and advance new treatments.

stories.sourceTitle: How Itaú is building generative AI for its entire customer base

stories.sourceExcerpt: With ia.i, a conversational interface, and the IARA governance platform, Itaú is applying its AI First strategy to customers and employees — in one of Brazil’s most regulated sectors.

stories.sourceExcerpt: Anant Kumar builds tools to compare loan valuations and analyze credit agreements, using Codex for code review and faster follow-ups.

stories.title: OpenAI 教师节推葡萄牙语 AI for Educators，用 Study Mode 支持提问式学习

stories.analysis: 教育 AI 的竞争点正从答题转向引导思考，教师工具的产品设计需要兼顾教学法和学生依赖风险。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Celebrate Teachers’ Day with AI for Educators in Brazilian Portuguese and see how Study Mode can help teachers support active, step-by-step learning.

stories.title: Sullivan & Cromwell 与 OpenAI 开发 Agreement Analyzer 审查合同问题
stories.sourceTitle: Sullivan & Cromwell brings legal expertise into agreement review
stories.summary: Sullivan & Cromwell 与 OpenAI 合作开发 AI 工具 Agreement Analyzer，用于识别草案协议中的问题。
stories.analysis: 律所自建合同审查工具，表明法律 AI 正从通用问答走向嵌入具体业务流程的专用应用。
stories.sourceExcerpt: In collaboration with OpenAI, Sullivan & Cromwell developed Agreement Analyzer, an AI tool for identifying issues in a draft agreement.

stories.title: SentinelOne 用 OpenAI Daybreak 把恶意软件分析从数周缩短到数小时
stories.sourceTitle: SentinelOne cuts malware analysis from weeks to hours
stories.summary: SentinelOne 借助 OpenAI Daybreak 将原本数周的恶意软件分析压缩到数小时，从而腾出容量调查更多威胁。
stories.analysis: 安全运营的瓶颈常在分析人力，AI 压缩调查周期会直接提升威胁覆盖量，但也要验证误报和可解释性。
stories.sourceExcerpt: With OpenAI Daybreak, SentinelOne cuts weeks of malware analysis to hours, creating capacity to investigate more threats.

stories.title: Higgsfield 用 GPT-6 Astra 把 AI 视频从 1 分钟拉到 10 分钟以上
stories.sourceTitle: Higgsfield takes AI video from 1 minute to over 10

stories.sourceExcerpt: Higgsfield brings creators longer videos with GPT-6 Astra, precise visuals with GPT-Image-2.5, and a path to voice filmmaking with GPT-Live.

stories.title: Sophos 用 OpenAI Daybreak 将威胁调查时间削减 96%

stories.analysis: 高比例自动化加人工监督是安全 AI 的务实路径，关键指标不只是提速，还包括处置质量和审计能力。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Discover how Sophos uses OpenAI’s Daybreak to cut cyber-threat investigation time by 96% and automate 52% of MDR cases while preserving human oversight.
